content: {"episode_id":"ep-05054","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, as reflected in diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1. Because these symptoms are intermittent, continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities is required to capture potential arrhythmic events, which shorter-term monitoring cannot reliably accomplish. The documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the monitoring service billed, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on that basis."}
